# Time

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/time` (default export). Time of day as `{ value: 'HH:MM' }` (24h) with hour-cycle/time-style display configuration and a time-slots presentation mode. Composed by Time Range.

## Usage
```ts
import TimeField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/time';
```

The contained example shows the serialized shape.
